anna_sales: Quick sync — FinBank wants an offline/sneakernet install for a pilot. Key asks: signed USB bundle, delta-only updates, max offline upgrade cadence, and a pricing estimate for a 6-mo POC. Any technical blockers we should flag?
priya_se: Re: bundle — size matters. If we ship full images it's big; we usually offer delta chunks. What format are they expecting on their side (airgapped K8s, VMs, bare-metal)?
jordan_infra: They said "airgapped K8s cluster with no egress" in the questionnaire. Main infra blockers: image signing + provenance, bundle chunking tool, and a validated offline installer that can apply deltas idempotently. Need to confirm kernel/container runtime compatibility.
mateo_cs: Also need to clarify support hours and SLA during the POC — on-prem onsite or remote support? That affects pricing.
anna_sales: Remote only. POC window 6 weeks for validation, then 6 months of support/observation. They want upgrade cadence no more than every 90 days ideally.
security_team: From an InfoSec perspective: must support signed SBOMs, chain-of-trust verification against their KMS/HSM, and an audit log of applied deltas. We'll need to provide a sample security questionnaire response for FIPS/TLS modes. Also confirm threat model for USB ingestion (we recommend USB staging via a hardened jumpbox).
priya_se: For signing: we can provide signed tarballs (.tar.gz + .sig) using our signing key, but customer typically wants a detached signature they can verify with their root key. Options: 1) We sign, they re-sign with their HSM; 2) We provide a cosign provenance that their attestation team can verify. Which do they prefer?
anna_sales: They prefer to keep the signing root in their HSM and only accept artifacts signed by them. Can we produce unsigned artifacts + instructions so they can re-sign, or do we need to support a re-sign flow?
jordan_infra: We can emit artifacts + reproducible SBOM and a small re-sign helper script. There's an ops cost: we usually run a one-off build inside a verified builder and hand over artifacts. Need to confirm who will run verification (their infra team or ours).
mateo_cs: For the POC we can offer a "staging handoff": we run the build and sign, hand USB image to their on-site tech, they re-sign and attest back to us. Documented process + checklist.
anna_sales: Pricing question — what is the delta-bundle/hand-off surcharge look like? They asked for a line item for airgap packaging, HSM support, and a one-time re-sign assist.
priya_se: Rough numbers (ballpark) for quoting: airgap packaging + docs + SBOM signing assist = $8k one-time; re-sign assist + runbook + 2h remote training = $3k one-time; extended POC support (24x5) = $6k/mo. If they want onsite tech for bootstrap, add hourly travel costs. These are draft; Jordan, sanity-check ops cost.
jordan_infra: Sanity check: packaging + testing (compat matrix, delta validation) is easily 5-7 dev days + 2 SRE days. $8k is reasonable if we constrain scope. Re-sign assist depends on HSM integration complexity — if they want us to integrate with their HSM APIs, that's a bigger engagement.
security_team: One more constraint: upgrade cadence. If they want <=90 days we can support it, but each delta must pass our regression/eval suite. Recommend introducing an acceptance gating step: their QA runs smoke tests post-install and returns a signed acceptance token. Otherwise we won't push auto deltas.
anna_sales: Noted. They asked whether delta bundles can be delivered as USB chunks with a manifest and a single verification command.
priya_se: Yes — typical delivery: USB payload layout: /artifacts/<artifact>.tar.gz, /artifacts/<artifact>.sig, /manifest.json, /sbom.json. Verification CLI (example):
```
# verify signature + checksum
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256
cosign verify --key customer_pubkey.pem artifacts/artifact.tar.gz.sig
# unpack and apply
sudo ./offline-installer apply --bundle artifacts/artifact.tar.gz
```
We provide the offline-installer binary and a small systemd unit for idempotent applies.
mateo_cs: We'll also include fallback instructions to restore previous artifact if apply fails (single-command rollback).
anna_sales: Deploybot — did a build for this customer's branch already land? artifact name?
deploybot: build 2024-09-18_1753 produced artifact: rbw-oc-offline-20240918.tgz (sha256: 3a7f...e1c9). Upload staged to s3://redwood-airgap-staging/finbank/20240918/
priya_se: Great — I'll pull that bundle and run local delta-validation. Jordan — can you run the compatibility smoke on k8s 1.25 and containerd 1.6?
jordan_infra: On it. ETA EOD tomorrow. I'll post logs in this thread.
security_team: I'll start drafting the security questionnaire responses and the SBOM template we will provide. Also need a short attestation template for their re-signing step.
anna_sales: Thanks team. Next actions: (1) Jordan run smoke tests (2) Priya validate delta/apply flow (3) Mateo draft staging handoff checklist (4) Security produce questionnaire answers + attestation template. I'll schedule a handoff call with FinBank for Thu 10am PT. Anyone need to block time?
priya_se: I can make Thu 10am.
jordan_infra: Free.
mateo_cs: Free.
security_team: I'll join the first 20 mins for the checklist review.
anna_sales: Perfect — I'll send calendar invite and include initial pricing ballpark so they can budget. :thumbsup:
